# Mandatory Requirements Assessment

| # | Requirement | Candidate |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Python | ✅ Met |
| 2 | SQL | ✅ Met |
| 3 | Linux administration | ✅ Met |
| 4 | Git | ✅ Met |
| 5 | REST API design | ✅ Met |
| 6 | Unit testing | ✅ Met |
| 7 | CI pipelines | ✅ Met |
| 8 | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm | ❌ Not met (none listed) |
| 9 | Kafka | ❌ Not met |
| 10 | GraphQL | ❌ Not met |

**Mandatory match: 7 of 10 = 70%**

Item 8 groups five technologies under one number. If each is counted separately, the match falls to **7 of 14 = 50%**. The candidate meets none of them, so either way the result is below the cutoff.

## ⚠️ Warning: Below the 78% Cutoff

The candidate's mandatory match of **70%** is below your **78% cutoff**. The gaps are concentrated in infrastructure, container tooling (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm), messaging (Kafka), and GraphQL.

As instructed, I did not evaluate the nice-to-have requirements.
